description: This file contains utility functions for environment-driven configurations and feature flags in a React frontend project. It provides helpers to parse environment variables into usable formats like CSV, JSON, booleans, and objects, specifically tailored for feature toggles, experiment flags, log levels, and retry configurations.

methods.name: parseCsvOrJson(value)
methods.description: Parses a string value as CSV, JSON array, or JSON object, returning the parsed value or null if invalid.

methods.name: getFeatureFlags()
methods.description: Retrieves feature flags from the environment variable REACT_APP_FEATURE_FLAGS, parsing it as CSV or JSON.

methods.name: isExperimentsEnabled()
methods.description: Determines whether experiments are enabled based on the environment variable REACT_APP_EXPERIMENTS_ENABLED, interpreting common true indicators.

methods.name: getLogLevel()
methods.description: Returns the logging level specified in REACT_APP_LOG_LEVEL or defaults to 'info'.

methods.name: getRetryConfig()
methods.description: Returns an object with retry configuration parameters derived from environment variables, with default fallback values.
